verdict.rationale: Kimi's own bundled Kimi Code agent (Desktop and CLI) is documented to edit files and run commands on a local project folder, so it can write and execute code against a user's local data. Nothing in the evidence shows the story's data-analysis outcomes: chart generation, computed answers from user datasets, or downloadable output files in the assistant chat. Missing for 10: documented chart/visualization output, a data-analysis workflow on uploaded files, downloadable generated files from the assistant, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant write and run code on my data to produce charts, computed answers, and downloadable files

citations.quote: let the Agent read code, edit files, run commands, and verify results through conversation.
read code, edit files, execute commands, search the web, and autonomously complete development tasks.
